args.message:
fix: use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) in round_money

Per FIN-212, round_money must round half to even. Replace
ROUND_HALF_UP with ROUND_HALF_EVEN so 2.665 rounds to 2.66.

args.head: fix/money-bankers-rounding
args.title: fix: use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) in round_money
args.body:
## Summary

The nightly build fails because `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, per FIN-212), but `src/money.py` uses `ROUND_HALF_UP`.

With `ROUND_HALF_UP`, `round_money(Decimal("2.665"))` returns `2.67` instead of the expected `2.66`.

## Change

- Replace `ROUND_HALF_UP` with `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` in `src/money.py`.

## Verification

- CI passed on branch `fix/money-bankers-rounding` (run `ci-0001`).
